name: Motorcycle
description: A road-registered motor vehicle with a seat or saddle and no more than three wheels on the ground. From January 1, 2027, an electric one rated above 8,000 W nominal is a motorcycle rather than a motor driven cycle; until then, with the motor driven cycle line drawn only by engine displacement, an electric two-wheeler beyond moped limits is a motorcycle.

restrictions.rule: A seat or saddle, and no more than three wheels on the ground; an autocycle isn't one
An electric motor rated above 8,000 W nominal; one from 750 W up to 8,000 W is a motor driven cycle
Riders need a driver's license with a Class M classification; riders aged 16 or 17 must also complete driver education and an IDOT-approved motorcycle training course
restrictions.citation: Illinois Vehicle Code §6-103; 92 Ill. Adm. Code 1030.30

restrictions.rule: Rider and passenger must wear glasses, goggles or a face shield unless it has a windshield that rises above the rider's eyes
Titled and registered with the Secretary of State, carries a license plate, and must carry liability insurance
One not built and equipped for highway use can't be registered and gets a distinctive title instead
Riders sit astride facing forward with at least one hand on the handlebars, and carry a passenger only if it's built for two
